description: Hypothesis that rising cross-venue spread entropy combined with liquidity thinning can precede micro-regime transitions.
hypothesized_mechanism: Fragmented liquidity and unstable spread formation reflect deteriorating market-making cohesion before volatility-state shifts.
evidence_supporting: intermittent lead-lag relationship in two historical windows

description: Hypothesis that high divergence among independently trained models indicates elevated uncertainty and increased failure risk.
